rendered:
The premise is not supported: NFA-A did not fall behind the NCA reference. The text reports the opposite. NFA-A kept ≈80%[1] capacity after 100[2] cycles, against ≈68%[3] for NCA, so NFA-A retained more capacity. The document states that the NFA-A variant had superior capacity retention[4] compared with the NCA cathode, and the capacity-retention figure shows the NFA-A curve above the NCA curve at the end of cycling. The gap therefore runs in NFA-A's favour, and there is no shortfall to report.
